title: Arlington Free Ride: one tap into a shared room of up to 20 riders
summary: A new main-menu item, Arlington Free Ride, needs no setup: one tap joins a shared room that is already riding Arlington Stream. Host-only checkpoint; not yet verified on the public site.
details: Shared rooms FREERD01 to FREERD25 hold up to 20 riders each and fill lowest first; rider 21 opens the next room. There are no host controls, no track changes and no invite link. Private multiplayer rooms keep the original four riders.

Riders on the default name get 'Rider ####'. A simple word filter replaces offensive names with 'Rider <slot>'. Motorcycles fall back to the stock ATV. The relay protocol is now v6, so older open tabs must reload.

Discovery: with 20 riders the browser decoded each relay message in its own worker round trip, dropped about 1,600 pose updates in 10 s and showed only 15 of 19 riders. It now decodes queued messages in batches.
Discovery: the remote model cache held only 8 distinct quad/rider models; it now holds 20. Off-screen name arrows are capped to the nearest 3 so labels stop piling up on phones.

Verification (host only: one Mac, Chromium/Metal headless, local wrangler relay, original content): tools/test_freeride.mjs ran 2 real browsers plus 18 synthetic riders at 20 Hz, each on a different model. Both browsers showed all 19 other riders with 0 dropped pose updates and 247 remote draws, at 70-85 FPS and 1-89 ms relay round trip, with at most 6 engine voices and 8 name tags. The 21st arrival opened FREERD02 and Leave returned to the main menu.
A relay-only run with 20 riders at 20 Hz handled about 400 messages/s in and about 7,600/s out.
limitation: Not yet verified on the public site. Production relay CPU with a full room, physical phones and real-world latency are not measured. Synthetic riders circle at a fixed height, so some sit under the terrain in screenshots. This is an authored browser mode, not an original-game online mode.
caption: Desktop (1280x896): a full Arlington Free Ride room with 19 remote riders, name arrows and the performance overlay. Portrait phone (390x844) and main-menu screenshots are stored alongside.
